title: Prism: rename the grammar helper insertBefore to insertTokensBefore
prompt: This is a copy of Prism 1.30.0 (the single-file bundle plus the per-language components). The helper on `Prism.languages` that inserts tokens into an existing grammar before a given key is called `insertBefore`, which reads like the DOM method of the same name. Rename it to `insertTokensBefore` everywhere: its definition and every place that calls or mentions it, in whichever files they live. The old name must not appear anywhere in the copy afterwards (comments included), `Prism.languages.insertBefore` must no longer exist, and every language must still load and highlight exactly as before.
